question: The deforestation drive in Kancha Gachibowli involved clearing land near which major educational institution in April 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Central University of Hyderabad**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **deforestation drive in Kancha Gachibowli** involved clearing land near the **Central University of Hyderabad**, which is a prominent educational institution located in Hyderabad.
 
• Kancha Gachibowli is an area located in close proximity to the Central University of Hyderabad, which is known for its sprawling green campus and biodiversity.
 
• The deforestation in this area was reportedly carried out in **April 2025**, raising concerns about the environmental impact and loss of green cover near the university.
 
• Such deforestation drives often occur to make way for urban expansion, infrastructure projects, or other developmental activities, but they also lead to debates on balancing development with environmental conservation.
